room_rent.note: Eligibility per Policy Schedule/variant; mainstream variant = Single Private Room (upgradable). 1%/day option on some variants

icu.note: Per Policy Schedule; some variants at actuals

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base; optional zone-based / age co-pay (Optional Cover 18) available

sub_limits.note: VERIFY per variant; some plan variants apply disease/room sub-limits per schedule

ped_waiting.note: Reducible to 24 months via Optional Cover 12 (PED reduction)

maternity.note: Benefit 15 inbuilt (Floater, age 18+); limit per schedule

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claims Bonus 10%/yr flat up to 50%; higher NCB Super via Optional Cover 4

restoration.note: Benefit 7 inbuilt; Unlimited Automatic Recharge via Optional Cover 3

organ_donor.note: Benefit 5; up to amount in schedule

ambulance.note: Benefit 4 road ambulance up to base SI; air ambulance via Optional Cover 14

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgeries listed as covered modern treatment

consumables.note: VERIFY; non-medical items generally excluded per Annexure II

global_cover.note: Benefit 15/17 Global Coverage on some variants; Optional Cover 1/13 for total/extended

notable_exclusions.display: Standard IRDAI exclusions (Excl01–18); non-medical/consumables per Annexure II

optional_riders.display: PED reduction (24mo), NCB Super, Unlimited Recharge, Air Ambulance, Global Coverage Total, Co-payment, Smart Select
